headline: ECB Rate Hike Imminent, Wall Street Braces
detail: The European Central Bank is set to raise rates, signaling tighter monetary policy. This creates headwinds for growth stocks and tech, as higher rates can reduce future earnings valuations and increase borrowing costs, impacting your margin-fueled portfolio.
rec: No direct trade from this headline alone, but it reinforces caution on highly leveraged or speculative positions.

headline: World’s Largest Chipmaker TSMC Sees Record Revenue Surge
detail: TSMC, a key player in the chip sector, reported a significant revenue increase. This is a strong positive signal for the semiconductor industry, a core part of your portfolio, suggesting robust underlying demand.
rec: Consider TSM as a new buy (scanner entry 434.12-433.69, stop 432.28) given the strong fundamental news and scanner setup.
